files.comprehensive.yml:

  authorColors:
    '*': '#ff0000'

  scrollPastBottom: true
  mouseEvents: true
  skipAmendWarning: false
  sidePanelWidth: 0.3

    activeBorderColor: ['green', 'bold']
    inactiveBorderColor: ['white']

    colorArg: always

    signOff: false

    args: '--no-edit'

    order: date-order

  openDirInEditor: ''
  open: ''
  openLink: ''

  universal:
    quit: 'q'
    quit-alt1: '<c-c>'

files.custom_cmds.yml:
customCommands:
  - key: 'a'
    context: 'files'
    command: 'git add {{.SelectedFile.Name}}'
    description: 'Stage file'
    subprocess: false
  - key: 'b'
    context: 'commits'
    command: 'git branch {{index .PromptResponses 0}} {{.SelectedCommit.Sha}}'
    prompts:
      - type: 'input'
        title: 'Branch name'
    description: 'Create branch'
    loadingText: 'Creating branch...'
  - key: 'c'
    context: 'global'
    command: 'echo test'
    stream: true
    showOutput: true
